title: Pellucid
summary: PELLU'CID, adjective [Latin pellucidus; per and lucidus; very bright. See Light.] Perfectly clear; transparent; not opake; as a body as pellucid as crystal.

inlines.v: PELLU'CID, adjective [Latin pellucidus; per and lucidus; very bright. See Light.] Perfectly clear; transparent; not opake; as a body as pellucid as crystal.
